root: ^Yeah I have a little somethin' you can 'elp with.
^See, our friends over in Chicago buy out our cider- can't get enough of it.
^I 'eard Marge's runnin' low on stock over there
^if y' don't mind deliverin' her some, we'd be happy to pay.

Accept: ^I'll get those sent over to yer vehicle. Just don't sample any on the way,
Reject: ^Well suit yerselves. If that changes, just come back and let me know.
